content:
{'translation': "Apple today unveiled the highly anticipated iPhone Duo, the company's first foldable iPhone. After the announcement, I managed to get a few minutes of hands-on time with the device to show you what it looks like in person.", 'translated_text': 'Apple 今日發表備受矚目嘅 iPhone Duo，係旗下首款可摺疊 iPhone。產品公布之後，我把握咗短短幾分鐘親身試玩，等大家睇下真機嘅樣子。'}

{'translation': "The iPhone Duo features a 7.6-inch Super Retina XDR inner display and a 5.4-inch outer display. The inner display uses a nano-texture matte finish, which reduces the visibility of the crease and minimizes glare. The effect is quite impressive — it's nearly imperceptible from most angles. The hinge design is also a showstopper.", 'translated_text': 'iPhone Duo 配備 7.6 吋 Super Retina XDR 內屏幕同 5.4 吋外屏幕。內屏幕採用 nano-texture 霧面處理，可以減少摺痕嘅視覺感並降低反光。效果相當唔錯，大部分角度都好難察覺到摺痕。鉸鏈設計亦令人眼前一亮。'}

{'translation': "The iPhone Duo is stunning both in person and in today's keynote video, with a remarkably forward-looking feel that's a genuine engineering breakthrough. The form factor will open up a host of new use cases for productivity and content consumption. The software experience is also impressive — particularly the progressive blur transitions when opening and closing the device, which are a real highlight.", 'translated_text': 'iPhone Duo 無論親眼睇或者睇今日 keynote 影片都同樣令人驚喜，手感非常前衛，仿如工程學上嘅一大突破。機身形態將會為生產力同內容消費帶來一大堆新穎玩法。軟件體驗亦相當出色，特別係開合手機時嘅漸進模糊過渡效果，相當亮眼。'}

{'translation': "More thoughts on today's Apple event to come later. The iPhone Duo will be available for pre-order starting October 16, with retail availability on October 23. Pricing starts at $1,999 for the 256GB model.", 'translated_text': '關於今日 Apple 發佈會嘅更多想法稍後同大家分享。iPhone Duo 將於 10 月 16 日開始預訂，10 月 23 日正式開賣。256GB 版本售價由 1,999 美元起。'}
